Name: Next-Gen Auto-Grabber
Author: palmhacker13
Description:
[center]
[size=6][b][color=#52c41a]Next-Gen Auto-Grabber[/color][/b][/size]
[size=4][i]An event-driven, zero-allocation universal auto-grabber for Stardew Valley 1.6+[/i][/size]

[b][color=#1890ff]Indoor & Outdoor Grabbing[/color]  •  [color=#fa8c16]Holographic Range Overlay[/color]  •  [color=#722ed1]Automate Pro & MCM Ready[/color][/b]
[/center]

[line]

[size=5][b]📖 What Does This Mod Do?[/b][/size]

[b]Next-Gen Auto-Grabber[/b] upgrades the vanilla Auto-Grabber into a high-speed, configurable collector that works [b]indoors and outdoors[/b] across your Farm, Greenhouse, Sheds, Barns, Coops, and Ginger Island—with zero per-frame garbage collection overhead.

Simply craft or place a vanilla [b]Auto-Grabber[/b] anywhere you want:
[list=1]
[*][b]Works Everywhere (Even When Empty)[/b]: Right-click any Auto-Grabber outdoors or indoors to open its storage chest at any time.[/*]
[*][b]Instant Placement & Live Sweeps[/b]: Placing an Auto-Grabber triggers an immediate collection sweep around it, and items/produce/truffles are gathered automatically on wake-up, time intervals, and object updates.[/*]
[*][b]Respects Automation Networks[/b]: Automatically skips machines connected to [b]Automate Pro[/b] or [b]Automate[/b] so it never steals inputs or breaks processing chains.[/*]
[/list]
[line]

[center]
[size=5][b]⚡ Ecosystem Synergy[/b][/size]
[/center]

[quote]
[b]Next-Gen Auto-Grabber[/b] pairs seamlessly with your mod setup (all optional):
[list]
[*][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/49437][b][color=#1890ff]Modern Config Menu (MCM)[/color][/b][/url] & [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098][b]GMCM[/b][/url]: Full in-game configuration menu with categorized options and tooltips.[/*]
[*][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/50971][b][color=#1890ff]UltraSmooth[/color][/b][/url]: Uses UltraSmooth spatial grid acceleration for fast lookups.[/*]
[*][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/55494][b][color=#1890ff]Automate Pro[/color][/b][/url]: Can push harvested items directly into [b]Automate Pro[/b] relay networks ([font=Courier New]EnableAmpNetworkPush[/font]) and automatically bypasses Automate-connected machines.[/*]
[/list][/quote]
[line]

[size=5][b]✨ Features[/b][/size]

[list]
[*][b]Flexible Range & Shapes[/b]: Choose [b]Radius[/b] (default 10 tiles), [b]GlobalLocation[/b] (entire map), or [b]GlobalWorld[/b] (all locations), with [b]Chebyshev Square[/b], [b]Euclidean Circle[/b], or [b]Manhattan Diamond[/b] geometry.[/*]
[*][b]Holographic Range Overlay[/b]: Bind a hotkey (e.g. [font=Courier New]NumPad9[/font]) or toggle in config to preview exact grabber coverage tiles in-game.[/*]
[*][b]Complete Farm & Foraging Coverage[/b]:
 
[list]
 [*]Crops, Indoor Pots, Giant Crops (optional), and Flowers (with built-in [b]Bee House flower protection radius[/b]).
  [/*]
[*]Fruit Trees, Wild Tree Seeds, Tree Moss, Tappers, Berry Bushes, Forageables, and Ground Debris.
  [/*]
[*]Farm Cave, Slime Balls, Animal Products, Truffles (instant pickup), Crab Pots (with [b]Auto-Bait[/b]), Fish Ponds, and Standalone Machines.
  [/*]
[*]Optional Wilderness Scavenging: Artifact Spots, Seed Spots, Garbage Cans, Ore Panning, Hardwood Stumps, and Green Rain Weeds.
  [/*]
[/list][/*]
[*][b]Auto-Reseed & Auto-Fertilize[/b]: Optionally replant seeds and apply fertilizer from the grabber's inventory when harvesting crops.[/*]
[*][b]Fair & Safe Controls[/b]: Exclude quest items, maintain an item ID blacklist, choose overflow handling ([b]SkipHarvest[/b] or [b]SpillAsDebris[/b]), award Farming/Foraging XP with player professions, and optionally set a per-item gold fee.[/*]
[/list]
[line]

[size=5][b]📥 Installation & Menu Support[/b][/size]

[list=1]
[*]Install [b]SMAPI[/b] (version 4.0.0+).[/*]
[*]Download and unzip [font=Courier New]NextGenGrabber[/font] into your [font=Courier New]Stardew Valley/Mods[/font] folder.[/*]
[*]Configure settings via [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/49437][b]Modern Config Menu (MCM)[/b][/url], [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098][b]Generic Mod Config Menu (GMCM)[/b][/url], or [font=Courier New]config.json[/font].[/*]
[/list]
[line]

[size=5][b]💻 Console Commands[/b][/size]

[list]
[*][font=Courier New][b]grabber_sweep [heavy|light][/b][/font] — Manually triggers a Next-Gen Grabber sweep for testing and benchmarking.[/*]
[/list]
